title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstarts for the docs site. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-ready examples that show how to wire Redwood runtimes to local vector stores and external tools (search, SQL, calendar) and demonstrate structured tool-calling patterns and agent fallbacks. This PR includes: 1) three agent templates (faq-bot, multi-tool-assistant, and summarizer) with explicit prompt templates and KV cache recommendations; 2) tool-calling examples showing function signatures and structured JSON outputs for search and SQL; 3) quickstart guides for redwood-examples and redwood-quickstarts repos with step-by-step local-run instructions; 4) docs site updates (new quickstart pages, updated sidebar, and code sandbox embeds); 5) unit and integration test harness updates for examples. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and README docs - [x] Add tool-calling examples and typed response schemas - [x] Add quickstarts and local run instructions - [x] Update docs site navigation and add code sandboxes - [x] Add tests and CI config for examples - [x] Address reviewer feedback and squash commits Testing notes: examples validated locally using redwood-cli dev mode and redwood-sdk-python; integration tests exercise tool calling end-to-end using a hermetic mock-search service. Follow-ups: add additional SQL example for pagination (ENG-5201) and an enterprise deployment note for Dedicated capacity (DOC-330).
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial add of templates and examples; docs site pages and sidebar update; test harness and CI adjustments; address reviewer feedback (fix lint, add edge-case tests); squash and prepare for merge.

Carlos Mendes: Docs build failed on first run due to a broken code-sandbox config, fixed and re-ran; integration tests flaked once but passed after increasing mock timeout. Approving after tests pass.
